title: VisualizerSpec

summary.description: The header's summary pill (default: worked out from the data, e.g. "Nodes: 7").

terrain.description: What the cell is: land, water, a wall, the start…

cluster.description: The island the cell belongs to.

heat.description: 0 to 1, drawn on the grid's colour scale.

note.description: A small second value in the corner, like a cost or a DP entry.

notes.description: More facts shown when the pointer rests on the cell.

oneOf.description: An edge, by its two ends.

arrows.description: Arrows from this cell to others, like the predecessor a path came from.

items.description: One grid cell's look. In a step's changes, only the fields given change.

islands.description: Islands to outline (an islands visualizer finds its own).

checkerboard.description: Shade alternate cells, like a chess board.

inferTerrain.description: Read what a plain value says a cell is (default: yes): 1 is land and 0 water, "S" the start, "T" or "E" the target, "#" or "wall" a wall. A cell's own CellSpec.Terrain always wins.

root.description: The root's id (default: the first node).

pointer.description: A small tag drawn next to the node, like a pointer's name.

note.description: A second, smaller line of text on the node.

notes.description: More facts shown when the pointer rests on the node.

directed.description: Whether edges have a direction (default: yes); an edge can say otherwise for itself.

id.description: Unique within the graph; edges, highlights and events name the node by it.

label.description: The text on the node (default: its id).

size.description: The node's radius in pixels (default: the studio's).

pointer.description: A small tag drawn next to the node, like a pointer's name.

note.description: A second, smaller line of text on the node, like a distance.

notes.description: More facts shown when the pointer rests on the node.

truncated.description: The list goes on past this node, but no further nodes are drawn.

head.description: The first node's id (default: the first node).

chains.description: The heads of other lists drawn with it, e.g. the two lists being merged.

stackChains.description: Draw each chain on its own row instead of one after another.

markCycle.description: Mark the node a cycle closes on (default: yes); the studio finds the cycle from the next pointers. A node in the cycle state is always marked.

label.description: A name under the item or bar.

pointer.description: A small tag drawn over the bar, like a pointer's name.

items.description: One array item's or bar's look. In a step's changes, only the fields given change.

min.description: The value axis (default: from zero, or the lowest value, to the highest).

showIndices.description: The index under each bar (default: on).

description.description: A line of text under the bars.

shade.description: A band drawn across a run of bars, like the water trapped between them.

id.description: Names the shape in click events.

tooltip.description: Shown when the pointer rests on the shape.

id.description: Names the shape in click events.

tooltip.description: Shown when the pointer rests on the shape.

id.description: Names the shape in click events.

tooltip.description: Shown when the pointer rests on the shape.

id.description: Names the shape in click events.

tooltip.description: Shown when the pointer rests on the shape.

id.description: Names the shape in click events.

tooltip.description: Shown when the pointer rests on the shape.

anyOf.description: Text starting at (TextShapeSpec.X, TextShapeSpec.Y), or centred on it; its colour is ShapeSpec.Fill.

items.description: A shape on a canvas. Its type says which: rect, circle, line, arrow or text.

state.description: What the steps start from, and what is drawn when there are no steps.

color.description: Optional; the studio gives each pointer its own colour otherwise.

items.description: A named marker on an element, like i and j over an array or slow on a list node. An array pointer may sit one place before or after the items (-1, or hi = n), as loops leave them.

pointers.description: Pointers drawn when there are no steps (each step shows its own).

highlight.description: Elements lit up when there are no steps (each step lights up its own).

cells.description: Grid cells, by row and column.

items.description: Array items and bars, by index.

nodes.description: Tree, graph and list nodes, by id.

edges.description: Graph edges, by their two ends.

highlight.description: Elements lit up in this step, e.g. the cell being visited or the current window of an array.

notes.description: Facts about this step shown beside the drawing, e.g. {"sum": "12"}.

count.description: How many items it held; WatchSpec.Items may show fewer.

items.description: A collection the algorithm keeps, as it was at a step: its first items in the order they come out.

watches.description: Collections the algorithm keeps (a queue, a stack, a set), as they were at this step.

line.description: The 1-based line of code that recorded the step, to highlight it in the editor.

source.description: Which code that line is in (a notebook cell), when it isn't the code that showed the visualizer.

items.description: One step of an algorithm. It shows a new VisualizerStepSpec.State, or the previous state with VisualizerStepSpec.Changes applied, or (with neither) the previous state as it was. Its highlights, pointers and notes belong to it alone.

showCoordinates.description: Row and column numbers around a grid (default: on).

showValues.description: The values inside cells and bars (default: on).

cellSize.description: A grid cell's size in pixels at 100% (default: 38).

fitOnOpen.description: Shrink the drawing to fit when it first appears, if it would otherwise be cut off (default: on).

fourDirectional.description: Only up, down, left and right count as touching (default: yes; no adds the diagonals).

recordSteps.description: Record the search step by step (default: yes).

islands.description: For VisualizerKind.Islands: how the studio finds the islands and records its search.

traversal.description: For a tree without steps: have the studio record this traversal.

detectCycle.description: For a linked list without steps: have the studio record Floyd's cycle detection.

width.description: The widest the visual is drawn, in pixels; it still fits narrower space. Left out, it takes the width there is.

height.description: The drawing's height in pixels, under the header. Left out, the studio picks one for the kind.

description: A data-structure visualizer (application/vnd.fry.visualizer.v1+json): a grid, tree, graph, list, array, bars, board or canvas in VisualizerSpec.State, and optionally the VisualizerSpec.Steps of an algorithm walking over it.
